messages:
Maya (CS): heads-up — PolarisHealth onboarding: noticed around ~30% token cost increase and p95 tail spikes after enabling auto-summarize. renewal in 6w, want low-risk optimizations (cost + tail) without hurting discharge note accuracy.
Sam (Solutions): can you paste a couple of example prompts and token length distro? any sample outputs that regressed?
Maya (CS): short dump: token mix: 60% <=128, 30% 129-1024, 10% >1024. p95 went from ~1.9s to ~3.4s for >1024 tokens after the feature. no clear quality regression reported yet but clinicians flagged some wording differences on discharge conclusions.
Jordan (Polaris): accuracy on conclusions is the main concern for us. templates should be safe, but freeform narrative must be exact. we need rollback criteria defined.
Nikhil (Eng-ML): propose a hybrid: int8 quantized compact model for templated flows + prefix-based routing; full model for freeform/critical intents. add uncertainty detector to fallback.
Miguel (SRE): ops: enable KV caching for repeated template prefixes to cut token churn. confirm retention/TTL aligns with PHI policy.
Sam (Solutions): rough canary config suggestion:
```json
{
  "traffic_split": {"compact-q1": 0.2, "full-v3": 0.8},
  "quant_profile": "int8-safe",
  "routing": [
    {"match": "header:X-Polaris-Template", "route": "compact-q1"},
    {"match": "intent:critical", "route": "full-v3"}
  ],
  "excludes": ["/compliance/review/*"]
}
```
Maya (CS): Jordan — can your team add a header like `X-Polaris-Template: discharge_v2` for server-side calls? That will make routing deterministic.
Jordan (Polaris): yes, we can add that. estimate 2 dev days to ship. we'll also flag audited endpoints to be excluded.
Nikhil (Eng-ML): I'll build a 50-example eval set (golden discharge notes) to run ROUGE and a small clinical QA checklist comparing full-v3 vs compact-q1 int8. will surface any hallucination regressions.
Sam (Solutions): add staged rollout plan: 48h shadowing -> 5% traffic for 6h -> 20% if stable. alerts on quality and latency.
Miguel (SRE): deploy-bot, schedule as Sam described and enable auto-rollback if p99 > 4s or quality drop > 2%.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: shadow=48h, rollout=5% for 6h, auto-rollback thresholds set. link=https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/1712469001
Maya (CS): action items for renewal deck: cost delta estimate, rollback criteria, eval results, timeline. I'll run customer enablement session to tag templates.
Jordan (Polaris): confirmed. please include exclusion list for endpoints that require compliance logs.
Nikhil (Eng-ML): noted. I'll instrument uncertainty score and log mismatches to a private bucket for manual review.
Maya (CS): thanks everyone 44d I'll report back after 72h of shadowing and share initial eval numbers.
Jordan (Polaris): appreciate the low-risk plan.
Maya (CS): closing: Maya to sync with Polaris, Jordan to add header + exclusions, Nikhil to prepare eval harness, Sam to finalize canary config, Miguel to run canary.
